_comment: Rodin MCP text-to-3D prompts used to generate assets/source/rodin/<id>.glb. Style suffix is appended to every prompt.
style: Stylized 3D fighting game character, full body, standing in A-pose, hand-painted stylized look, clean silhouette, game-ready.

characters.gembel-lampu-merah: lean Indonesian street drifter man, faded green bucket hat, long black hair, worn olive-green jacket over red t-shirt, brown cargo pants, black sandals, small ukulele strapped on his back
characters.kasir-minimarket: young Indonesian woman minimarket cashier, blue polo shirt uniform with red collar trim, navy hijab headscarf, black trousers, white sneakers, name tag, confident smile
characters.guru-matematika: middle-aged Indonesian male math teacher, khaki safari civil-servant shirt, brown trousers, thick glasses, neat side-parted hair, holding a long wooden ruler, chalk dust on sleeves
characters.pesilat: athletic Indonesian pencak silat master, black silat uniform with golden songket sash, traditional black headband cloth (destar), barefoot, focused calm expression
characters.preman-pasar: burly Indonesian market thug, black tank top, gold chain, red bandana, scar on cheek, tattooed arms, ripped jeans, black boots, intimidating grin
characters.tukang-parkir: Indonesian parking attendant man, bright orange vest over blue shirt, baseball cap, whistle on a cord around his neck, dark trousers, flip-flops
characters.satpam-komplek: stocky Indonesian neighbourhood security guard, navy blue uniform with patches, white peaked cap, black belt with baton, black boots
characters.abang-bakso: Indonesian meatball soup street vendor man, thick moustache, white t-shirt, green apron, straw hat, holding a ladle, sarong around waist
characters.emak-emak-komplek: plump Indonesian housewife, purple house dress (daster), yellow hijab, flip-flops, holding a flip-flop sandal as a weapon, hands on hips, stern face
characters.kuntilanak: Indonesian ghost woman Kuntilanak, very long black messy hair covering part of the pale face, long flowing white dress, floating, spooky but stylized
characters.pocong: Indonesian ghost Pocong, figure wrapped completely in white burial shroud tied at head and feet, pale face visible, stylized cartoon horror
characters.buto-ijo: Javanese green giant Buto Ijo, huge muscular green-skinned ogre, tusks, small horns, wild black hair, brown loincloth, golden armbands
characters.genderuwo: Javanese forest spirit Genderuwo, tall hulking ape-like creature covered in dark shaggy fur, glowing red eyes, long arms
characters.wewe-gombel: Javanese spirit Wewe Gombel, tall thin woman with very long arms, long grey-black hair, tattered dark purple kebaya, eerie but stylized
characters.begu-ganjang: Batak tall shadow spirit Begu Ganjang, extremely tall thin dark figure, glowing blue eyes, long limbs, wrapped in dark ulos-patterned cloth
characters.leak-bali: Balinese Leak sorcerer, red and gold Rangda-style mask with fangs, long white hair, red and white Balinese costume, glowing yellow eyes
characters.orang-utan: stylized Bornean orangutan fighter, orange shaggy fur, very long arms, wide cheek pads, standing upright, green leaf wristbands
characters.bekantan: stylized proboscis monkey fighter, long nose, orange-brown fur, cream belly, long tail, standing upright, fighting stance
characters.komodo: stylized Komodo dragon fighter, large grey-green scaly lizard, long tail, forked tongue, powerful claws, low crouching stance
characters.harimau-sumatra: stylized Sumatran tiger fighter, orange fur with black stripes, standing upright, muscular, fierce expression
characters.cenderawasih: stylized bird of paradise spirit fighter from Papua, humanoid bird with golden yellow plumes, red and green feathers, long tail feathers, glowing
characters.nyi-roro-kidul: Javanese Queen of the Southern Sea Nyi Roro Kidul, regal woman in emerald green kebaya and golden crown, long flowing green sash, long black hair
characters.gatotkaca: Javanese wayang hero Gatotkaca, muscular knight in red and gold armour, golden crown (gelung), red cape, moustache, heroic pose
characters.si-pitung: Betawi folk hero Si Pitung, black traditional Betawi clothes (baju sadariah), red sarong over the shoulder, black peci cap, golok machete at the waist
characters.sangkuriang: Sundanese legendary hero Sangkuriang, muscular young man with long hair tied back, brown traditional clothes, green sash, holding a wooden oar
characters.jaka-tarub: Javanese legendary hero Jaka Tarub, handsome young man in blue and white traditional clothes, light flowing shawl cape, holding a bow
